description: This file defines a base activity class 'SampleActivityBase' for Android applications, extending FragmentActivity. It handles logging initialization and provides a base structure for activities within the sample app.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class that extends FragmentActivity, providing common logging setup and activity initialization for sample applications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; currently just calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity becomes visible; initializes logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging infrastructure by wrapping Android's log system with custom classes and outputs a 'Ready' message.
